Hospital Accident and Emergency Care Activity supporting information - NHS England Digital

This file provides some high level analyses of key ECDS data relating to A&E attendances in NHS hospitals, minor injury units and walk-in centres. This document provides data tables to support and to provide additional analysis. The annual publication covers the financial year ending March 2024 as well as earlier time periods.

The data source for this file is the Emergency Care Dataset (ECDS)
